findings.title: Vista Medical Center East down to 21 patients and closes a floor amid reports doctors may take over Waukegan hospital
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Vista Medical Center East had 21 patients on Thursday morning and that the hospital closed its fifth floor.
findings.access_consequences: A fifth-floor inpatient area was taken out of use. The report says 15 fifth-floor patients were relocated: four to the ICU and the rest to the second floor. It does not establish that admissions were refused, how many staffed beds were lost, or that a distinct specialty service was suspended. Pre-existing ambulance diversion and loss of trauma designation are not new findings.
findings.affected_population: Vista Medical Center East inpatients; 15 patients reportedly relocated, with unknown impact on prospective admissions.

coverage_notes.watch_type: Bounded supplementary recall; authoritative national production collection unchanged.

Hospital spokesperson was asked but management had not responded at publication. This is an actual floor closure, not a confirmed entire-hospital or specialist service shutdown. Pending production review.
